## Scope

- Re-check reusable asset candidates for portability and maintenance cost.
- Confirm ownership boundaries for governance-only files.

## Acceptance criteria

- Asset inventory is current and linked to concrete adoption decisions.
- Risk notes are explicit for each reusable asset group.
- Follow-on actions are assigned to policy or guide issues.
